implemented: Input-only reserved-stack rsp IR constraint with snapshot provenance checks
C +r(bound_rsp) normalization preserving source operand numbering without SSA SP result/writeback
Physical RSP substitution with no snapshot installation
ABI call barrier preserving live GPR/SIMD state
Compatible non-early fixed input/output sharing in balanced-stack mode
limits: Templates must restore RSP and preserve frame bases/DF, maintain call alignment and return normally. Unwinding/nonlocal exits/terminal transfers remain unsupported.
The marker does not infer call argument or return types. Stack arguments must be supplied by the template.
Only exact +r on a bound global RSP variable is accepted. Marker duplicates, output ties, narrow RSP views, competing fixed inputs and early-clobber overlaps reject.
Snapshot provenance is canonical StackSave to PtrToInt I64 with value aliases resolved; arbitrary integers, arithmetic, phis and reloads are rejected.
Kernel ABI, objtool, linking and boot remain unqualified.
